name.ja: Figure-rise Mechanics トランクスのタイムマシン

ja: 圧倒的なスケールでド迫力のタイムマシン登場！
• 全高300mmのド迫力スケール！同時発売のFigure-riseStandard超サイヤ人トランクスが搭乗可能！劇中の再現をトランクスと併せてディスプレイ展開が可能に！
• 内部メカを忠実に再現したこだわりのディテール。内部のメカ構造は本商品の為に新しく公式設定を追加！メカ構造を作りこめるFigure-riseMechanicsならではの商品！
• 外装には劇中登場のHOPE!!の文字をシールで再現！
• 付属品に劇中に登場したセルの抜け殻を付属。劇中に出てきたあのシーンも再現可能に！
en: A powerful time machine with overwhelming scale appears!

• Impressive Scale with a total height of 300mm! Simultaneously released Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan Trunks can be boarded! It is now possible to display the reproduction from the play along with the trunks!

• Special details that faithfully reproduce the internal mechanism. The internal mechanical structure has new official settings added for this product! A product unique to Figure-riseMechanics that allows you to create mechanical structures!
• The word HOPE!! that appears in the movie is reproduced on the exterior with a seal!
• An empty shell of the cell that appeared in the movie is included as an accessory. You can also recreate the scenes that appeared in the movie!
